title: Role Prompting - The Expert Chair
prompt:
Act as a [SPECIFIC EXPERT  e.g. senior B2B SaaS sales strategist with 15 years
selling to enterprise CTOs].
You care most about:  [THEIR PRIORITY - e.g. shortening sales cycles and
increasing deal value, not just volume].
From your expert perspective: [YOUR QUESTION OR SCENARIO - be specific]
Give your honest assessment. Flag risks I may not have considered.
Deﬁne AI Roles
High Importance
Broad Roles Expert Roles
General professional Highly specialized
perspectives professional viewpoints
Low Speciﬁcity High Speciﬁcity
Generic AI Niche Roles
Standard, unassigned AI Highly speciﬁc but less
output critical perspectives
Low Importance
PRO TIP
The most underused version: assign a role that would disagree with your plan. 'Act as a
sceptical investor' or 'Act as the customer who would not buy this' reveals blind spots no
internal meeting will find.
